title: Sweep discount and GAE horizons, prioritizing K1
doing: Propose a warm-start420 screen at K1/K4: direct per-decision gamma0.97/0.99/0.995 crossed with lambda0.90/0.95, plus the original game-time-matched K1 anchor. Keep reward, rollout allocation, batch, LR schedule and exposure fixed within contrasts; use at least2 training seeds per cell. Distinguish literal per-decision treatment from matched-game-time controls. No launch authorized.
expected: Shorter K1 credit traces may reduce noisy advantages or stabilize the critic and improve Q1 relative to the matched-horizon anchor. They may instead lose useful delayed credit and reduce survival; changing gamma also changes the discounted objective, so lower KL or variance alone is not success.

evidence.label: User-directed literature checklist handoff; papers are priors, not Dodge results
